ATTRIBUTE.Name: Staining ID
ATTRIBUTE.Description: A unique identifier of the Staining.
ATTRIBUTE.Explanation: The uniqueness refers to the context of the dataset. Defined by the data submitter.

Value_Specification.Comment: CAVEAT: During dataset creation the submitter must use the Object Attribute “alias” to state a unique identifier, however, during the submission process that repository automatically generates a unique accession ID for each submitted CMMS Entity. This accession ID will be automatically injected into the XML file using the xs:attribute “accession” by the repository during the upload process. Once an accession ID has been generated all references to a given CMMS Entity must use the xs:attribute “accession” and not the xs:attribute “alias”.

ATTRIBUTE.Name: Staining Compound
ATTRIBUTE.Description: The staining compound used that binds to parts of the tissues of a given Slide. Only mandatory if ATTRIBUTE ID 12.2.6: Staining Procedure has not been specified.
ATTRIBUTE.Explanation: For immunohistochemistry, immunofluorescence and in-situ hybridization staining reagents (i.e targeted stains) this field delineates the type of molecule used (i.e. Antibody, DNA, RNA).

Value_Specification.Comment:
For chemical stains: SCHEMA: • SNOMED CT Stain (substance) Concept and its children • OR free text if the compound is not present in SNOMED CT
For targeted stains: CONTROLLED VOCABULARY: • ‘antibody’ (if ATTRIBUTE ID 12.2.4 Staining Reporter Type == immunogenic) • ‘Double-stranded DNA’ (if ATTRIBUTE ID 12.2.4 Staining Reporter Type == in situ hybridization) • ‘Single-stranded DNA’ (if ATTRIBUTE ID 12.2.4 Staining Reporter Type == in situ hybridization) • ‘RNA’ (if ATTRIBUTE ID 12.2.4 Staining Reporter Type == in situ hybridization) • ‘Synthetic oligonucleotide’ (if ATTRIBUTE ID 12.2.4 Staining Reporter Type == in situ hybridization) OR (if nothing applies) • FreeText

ATTRIBUTE.Name: Staining Target
ATTRIBUTE.Description: The specific target of the stain. (e.g. Protein). Only conditionally mandatory for targeted stains (i.e. immunohistochemistry, immunofluorescence and in-situ hybridization).
ATTRIBUTE.Explanation: Currently this attribute is only specified for protein targets. For non-protein targets the value specification will be introduced on demand in future.

Value_Specification.Comment: For single target antibodies: SCHEMA: • HUGO Gene Nomenclature Commitee (HGNC) ID The value must be stated by using the HUGO Gene Nomenclature Commitee (HGNC) ID and approved symbol if target gene can be found. In cases where the target gene cannot be found a custom STRING can be entered. For multi-target antibodies: The submitter is free to state a value of their liking as a STRING (e.g. 'pan-cytokeratin', 'AE1+AE3')
